metadata.description: Verify no LOOP pool already includes spatial coherence as a signal member

finding.status: PASS — no spatial coherence signal in any LOOP pool
finding.detail: Spatial coherence is implemented as a MODULATOR (core/spatial_coherence.py → SpatialCoherenceGate), not a signal. It modulates existing signal confidences upward/downward based on regional agreement. It does not produce independent predictions and is not registered as a signal in POOL_DEFINITIONS.
evidence: POOL_DEFINITIONS in core/signal_families.py line 578: 11 pools listed — none include spatial coherence
SpatialCoherenceGate in core/spatial_coherence.py: implements modulate_confidence(), not evaluate() — it's a modulator
signal_fusion.py line 155: spatial_coherence is listed under 'modulators' dict, not under 'signal_predictions'
PoolOfPools.evaluate() uses spatial_coherence from modulators arg, not from pool_members
finding.recommendation: No action needed. Spatial coherence is correctly implemented as a fusion-stage modulator. Adding it as a pool member would create circular signal dependency.
